WildSpark 2.2.13 fixes gathering skill display on minimap node tooltips. Nodes now show the node name plus required skill level and an explicit profession requirement, color-coded by the player's current skill. Fallbacks cover minimap tooltips built through either SetText or AddLine when tooltip-data callbacks are unavailable.

Rare-spawn reference timers remain included and labeled unverified for WoW Forever; local and peer-shared observations remain primary.
